g.text: Short transaction: claim task + GPU A
Persist token 41, lease expiry and budget reservation
Start with token 41 and hard deadline
Write checkpoint data, then complete manifest
Host watchdog stops before its safe lease deadline
Mark attempt lost; QUARANTINE GPU A
Never treat lease expiry as proof that the GPU is idle.
GPU A stays unavailable until termination and health are confirmed.
If retry count + conservative budget permit:
claim healthy GPU B; issue token 42
Verify manifest / hashes; restore training state
Reject stale token; no canonical state change
Confirm process stopped and device healthy
Release GPU A quarantine only after confirmation
Write immutable attempt artifacts + complete manifest
Complete task and enqueue next stage atomically
After EVALUATE passes, CPU PUBLISH checks the exact artifact/report.
Model READY + job READY commit together; uniqueness prevents duplicates.
At-least-once execution, fenced and effectively-once publication.
